purpose: Regenerate eight original flagship project covers in the current photorealistic editorial style. Generated illustrations are not real experimental evidence.

entries.prompt:
Create ONE landscape 3:2 high-resolution editorial photographic cover for an ambitious teenage science/engineering course. Mature, exceptionally detailed and credible, inviting warmth with restrained cinematic contrast, natural material textures and convincing real optics. Subject large and legible at card size, all main parts inside the central 80% with generous crop-safe margins. No text headings, no logos, no watermarks, no cartoon, no sepia illustration, no exploded parts, no floating holograms, no glossy toy render. Equipment belongs in an achievable student project. Every custom structural part is visibly fine-layer FDM printed polymer with sound ribbing, fillets, fasteners and practical cable routing; only simple off-the-shelf motors/sensors/screws/electronics may be metal. No machined custom-metal fabrication, no expensive industrial lab. Unique setting and camera framing for this subject. This is an AI-generated cover illustration, not experimental evidence.
SUBJECT: A sophisticated 35 cm six-wheel terrain-classification rover prototype, charcoal and bone-white 3D-printed ribbed chassis and rocker suspension, rubber tires, small geared motors, ordinary bolts, a compact stereo camera mast and an open top electronics bay with organized wiring. The rover is the dominant hero in a low three-quarter front view, driving across a small rust-red grit and basalt test tray on a school maker bench, one front wheel raised on a stone. Clearly a desktop Earth analogue test, NOT a full-scale NASA spacecraft. In the softly defocused background, daylight through workshop glazing and a single monitor showing a red Martian terrain patch beside a simple segmented terrain map, no readable text. Warm copper daylight meets restrained cool shadows. Crisp plausible assembly joints, no impossible floating parts. Wide composition keeps all six wheels and mast visible with margins.
